items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 1:04 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Water Allocation Bylaw and Policy and Zoning By-law Amendment ZBA26-004-COK-GS, DSD-2026-273
notes:
Council considered Development Services Department report DSD-2026-272, entitled City of Kitchener Water Allocation Policy and By-law Zoning By-law Amendment ZBA26/004/COK/GS, dated June 25, 2026, recommending approval of a Zoning By-law Amendment Application and Water Allocation Policy in the form presented on the agenda this date. Council was also in receipt of a written submission from M. Parker regarding this matter.

Garett Stevenson, Director of Development and Housing Approvals, presented the report, noting the development process is intended to run concurrently with the development approvals process and is not expected to result in any additional costs. He further noted that staff had consulted with the development community and, stakeholders have been supportive of the approach, indicating that the policy will provide greater clarity and predictability moving forward.

Matt Parker was in attendance in support of both the Zoning By-law Amendment Application and the Water Allocation Policy. However, he requested an amendment to the staff recommendation directing the General Manager of the Development Services Department to provide Council with regular status reports on water allocations assigned by the Region, as outlined in the City of Kitchener Prioritization Framework, to support transparent decision-making in accordance with the City of Kitchener's Corporate Accountability and Transparency Policy.

In response to questions from Council, Mr. Stevenson stated that communications regarding water allocation and capacity need to be clear and concise. He noted that staff had issued media releases as recently as the previous week to advise the public of the report being considered this date. J. Readman further advised that staff provide Council with quarterly development approval reports and anticipate including updates on water capacity matters in those reports going forward. Mayor B. Vrbanovic added that significant work had been undertaken over the past six months to address water capacity issues and identify solutions that will enable development to continue.

Mr. Stevenson also responded to questions regarding developments approved during the first half of the year with holding provisions in place and the process for removing those provisions. He further addressed questions related to transparency and future reporting on water allocation matters, noting that staff will continue to seek opportunities to communicate updates to both Council and the public.

motions.item_title: Water Allocation Bylaw and Policy and Zoning By-law Amendment ZBA26-004-COK-GS, DSD-2026-273
motions.text: "That Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA26/004/COK/GS, to amend Zoning By-law 85-1, for the City of Kitchener, be approved in the form shown in the ‘Proposed By-law’ attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2026-273 as Attachment A; and, That Zoning By-law Amendment Application ZBA26/004/COK/GS, to amend Zoning By-law 2019-051, for the City of Kitchener, be approved in the form shown in the ‘Proposed By-law’ attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2026-273 as Attachment B; and, That the General Manager of Development Services Department be authorized to execute an Allocation Policy Administrative Agreement with the Region of Waterloo; and, said agreement to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor; and, That the General Manager, Development Services be authorized to execute all tri-party Forward Looking Servicing Agreements with the Region of Waterloo and an Owner/Proponent, in accordance with the Region of Waterloo Policy: Water Supply Capacity Allocation Policy for the Mannheim Service Area, said agreements being to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor; and, That the proposed Water Allocation Policy, for the City of Kitchener, be approved in the form shown as attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2026-273 as Attachment C, and further, That all by-laws related to this mater, for the City of Kitchener, be approved in the form shown as attached to Development Services Department report DSD-2026-273 as Attachments A, B, and C be forwarded to the Council meeting later this date as late starter by-laws for approval."
